query: WITH living_saudis AS (SELECT * FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala WHERE person_type = 'Saudi' AND (person_status = 'صالح' OR death_date IS NULL)), gender_counts AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_saudis, SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_count FROM living_saudis) SELECT (male_count / CAST(total_saudis AS DOUBLE)) * 100 AS male_percentage FROM gender_counts LIMIT 100
